Northern & Central Dalmatia

The heart of the programme, reaching north to Zadar. Diocletian’s stone and the islands at sea, the Cetina canyon and the Biokovo balconies above, Zadar’s peninsula and the Kornati archipelago, with the Krka waterfalls inland — active Dalmatia at its most complete.
